subject: AtlasHealth workspace ignition & API key cadence
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Kim Park <kim.park@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jul 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AtlasHealth workspace ignition & API key cadence

Hi Kim —

Congrats again on signing — excited to get AtlasHealth into production. Per our kickoff today, attaching a lightweight keying matrix and a short checklist to align the first-week work. Goal: get a seeded org, 2 service accounts, and first-stage API keys for your staging environment by next Tuesday (2029-07-09).

Key asks from our side:
- Confirm the desired project name(s) for the workspace (staging / staging-internal / prod).
- Confirm whether keys should be pinned to a customer KMS (we support AWS KMS & GCP KMS) or if Redwood-managed ephemeral keys are OK for staging.
- Any compliance gating (IP allowlist, strict egress) we should pre-configure.

Attached: atlas_initial_keying_matrix.csv (seed roles & service-account mapping) and tenant-activation-checklist.pdf (first-week milestones).

Next steps I suggest:
1) You confirm project name + KMS choice.
2) Ben will create two service accounts and seed initial API keys into the staging namespace.
3) We run a 30-minute handoff call to validate keying and sample calls.

I can host the call Tue 7/9 10:00–10:30 PDT or Wed 7/10 8:00–8:30 PDT — what works?

Thanks — Naomi

--
Naomi Feldman
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

Attachments: atlas_initial_keying_matrix.csv (spreadsheet), tenant-activation-checklist.pdf (PDF)

From: Kim Park <kim.park@atlashealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: implementations@atlashealth.com
Date: Thu, 4 Jul 2029 09:56:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AtlasHealth workspace ignition & API key cadence

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. Quick clarifications from our side:

1) Project names: staging-atlas, staging-int, prod-atlas (we'll create prod after staging validation).
2) KMS: For now we want Redwood-managed keys for staging to keep the early iteration fast; for prod we'll migrate to our AWS KMS.
3) IP allowlist: We'll provide a short list (two CIDR blocks) by EOD today.

Call: Tue 7/9 10:00–10:30 PDT works for our implementation lead.

One ask: can the staging keys be created as short-lived (24h) and surfaced via the console + a seeded secret in our vault for automated smoke tests? If not, we'll accept long-lived keys and rotate later.

Thanks,
Kim

--
Kim Park
Director, Integrations | AtlasHealth
kim.park@atlashealth.com | +1 212-555-2044

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Kim Park <kim.park@atlashealth.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jul 2029 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: AtlasHealth workspace ignition & API key cadence

Ben / Monica — looping you in for the seed work. Kim confirmed project names and wants Redwood-managed staging keys (short-lived if supported). Can we do the following?

- Ben: create the two service accounts (svc-atlas-staging-smoke, svc-atlas-staging-ingest) in the staging-atlas project and seed initial API keys. Mark keys as 24h TTL if possible. If TTL isn't feasible for console-managed keys, create standard keys and flag for rotation policy.
- Monica: coordinate the handoff call on Tue 7/9 10:00 PDT and prepare the 10-min demo (console key rotation + example call).

Ben — if you can reply with task ETA + whether console secrets support 24h TTL, Kim will accept Vault-seeded short-lived tokens as an alternative.

Thanks — Naomi

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Kim Park <kim.park@atlashealth.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Jul 2029 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AtlasHealth workspace ignition & API key cadence

Thanks Naomi — plan below and I'll take ownership of the seed tasks.

Work to do (ETA = Fri 7/5 EOD):
- Create project "staging-atlas" namespace and two service accounts: svc-atlas-staging-smoke, svc-atlas-staging-ingest.
- Generate API keys for both accounts and upload a short CSV to the secure onboarding Drive (link below).
- Configure keys as expiring tokens set to 24h TTL. If our console-managed key store cannot enforce TTL for API keys, I'll instead create short-lived bearer tokens via the token-service and seed a one-day secret into the AtlasHealth Vault.
- Add IP allowlist entries once Kim provides CIDRs.

Notes:
- Console supports ephemeral tokens via the token-service (recommended) — I will generate ephemeral tokens and show the flow in the call.
- I will attach a quick runbook (seed_runbook.md) with exact CLI commands and the Drive location for the seeded secrets.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cAtlasOnboard (I'll populate with csv + runbook)

Attachments: seed_runbook.md (text)

Ben

From: Kim Park <kim.park@atlashealth.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jul 2029 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AtlasHealth workspace ignition & API key cadence

Thanks Ben — that works for us. We will provide the two CIDR blocks by EOD today and confirm the vault path to seed (atlas/staging/ci). Looking forward to the call Tue 7/9 10:00 PDT — adding our implementation lead Daniel Lee to the invite.

Approve the plan and note: we'll want a short note in the runbook to show how to rotate to AWS KMS when we switch for prod.

Best,
Kim
